SELECT 
    CO.orderid,
    TO_CHAR(CO.orderedat, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') as OrderDate,
    CO.selectedaddress,
    STRING_AGG(MI.Name || ' (x' || ORDI.Amount::text || ')', ', ') as Items,
		CO.totalcost
FROM public.customerorder CO
JOIN public.ordereditem ORDI ON CO.orderid = ORDI.orderid
JOIN public.menuitem MI ON ORDI.itemid = MI.itemid
JOIN public.customer C ON CO.customerid = C.customerid
WHERE C.email = {{appsmith.store.currentUser}}
GROUP BY CO.orderid, CO.orderedat, CO.selectedaddress
ORDER BY CO.orderid DESC;

actionConfiguration.body:
WITH new_order AS (
	INSERT INTO CustomerOrder (CustomerId, SelectedAddress, TotalCost)
	SELECT customerid, {{ appsmith.store.selectedLocation }}, {{this.params.totalCost}}
	FROM public.customer
	WHERE email = {{appsmith.store.currentUser}}
	RETURNING OrderId
)
INSERT INTO OrderedItem (OrderId, ItemId, Amount)
SELECT 
    (SELECT OrderId FROM new_order), 
    itemid, 
    quantity
FROM json_to_recordset( {{JSON.stringify(appsmith.store.cart)}}::json ) 
AS cart_data(itemid int, quantity int);
